description: Migrated from the v1 allowlist (window.all + dialog.open). The frontend (src/app.js) only calls our own #[tauri::command] functions via invoke() — no window or dialog JS globals — so only core:default is needed here. The native file-picker is invoked from Rust (load_geojson_file via DialogExt), which is not gated by frontend capabilities; the tauri-plugin-dialog plugin still must be registered in main.rs.
